headline: Anthropic clarifies data usage policies as feedback feature raises privacy questions
body: Anthropic published guidance on how user chat feedback is handled in Claude, addressing growing concerns about data retention and model training. For healthcare organizations deploying Claude in clinical workflows, this clarification matters: any feedback loop integrating with EHR systems or patient data requires explicit understanding of what gets retained and how it flows into future model updates. Healthcare vendors evaluating Anthropic as an AI backbone need to audit these policies against HIPAA requirements and validate that sensitive patient information doesn't inadvertently train future models. The transparency signals a necessary step, but healthcare teams should demand contractual guarantees around data isolation before scaling deployment in regulated environments.
